about: Generated industry imagery for the Greenstop Wellness redesign pitch "STREET GLASS" (IMAGERY lane, 2026-11-03): glassmorphism crossed with graffiti street culture. Night scenes in deep forest green with a lime chartreuse signal glow, abstract graffiti made of shapes only (never readable letters or words), frosted glass and soft light streaks, plus a consistent set of category still lifes and three cut-outs that protrude past their frames. Every image is illustrative industry mood only: none stands in for Greenstop's store, staff, customers, products or a real place, and none is captioned as a photograph of them. Every alt describes what is depicted. Greenstop's own photos and videos live in assets/photos/gs/ and assets/media/gs/ (another lane). g-city-dusk was tried on Higgsfield Soul first; that request was not accepted, so every still here is FLUX 1.1 Pro Ultra on fal (cut-outs: BiRefNet v2 on fal). Each entry carries its by-eye review; prompt is the prompt of the shipped attempt, retryPrompt the last rejected retry where one was run. Run: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project>.

A soft glowing lime-green spray-paint haze drifts in from the left edge of the frame, wet black asphalt in the foreground mirrors the colours in long reflections, two or three soft diagonal streaks of light diffused as if seen through frosted glass. Composition: the left 45 percent of the frame is calm, dark and almost empty, deep green shadow with only the faint haze, the mural is concentrated in the right half of the frame. Empty street at night, moody high contrast, clean modern editorial look, 35mm photograph, fine grain
